subject: SIG questionnaire initiation and scheduling — clarifying ownership & SOC 2 status
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Burns <caroline@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation and scheduling — clarifying ownership & SOC 2 status

Caroline,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the clear overview of HealthBridge's upcoming rollout. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can kick off the vendor security questionnaire efficiently: 

- SIG vs CAIQ: from our call it sounded like you prefer the SIG (more prescriptive to your team). Can you confirm? If you prefer CAIQ we can switch — both are fine.
- SOC 2: you mentioned a SOC 2 report is in progress. Can you confirm the expected completion quarter and whether we'll get a Type II (or Type I initially)?
- HIPAA/GDPR: you flagged HIPAA as in-scope for the integration and GDPR for EU users. Please confirm the primary compliance focus (HIPAA only / HIPAA + GDPR).
- Evidence owners: to avoid back-and-forth, who on your side will own encryption/networking evidence and who will own dataflow/PII classification? Provide names and emails if possible.
- Timeline: what internal timeline do you have for sign-off on vendor security so we can align; e.g., a one-week turnaround vs multi-week?

Next steps I propose:
1) I can push the SIG spreadsheet (attached) and a short mapping doc to your security mailbox.
2) Two kickoff windows: Mon 5/31 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 6/2 14:00–14:30 PT — pick whichever works and I’ll calendar invite.
3) Jordan will loop legal if contract redlines are requested during onboarding.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_template.xlsx (stub) — the spreadsheet has section owners and a short evidence checklist.

If you want to hand off to your security team directly, please send their preferred contact (email + preferred time zone) and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks — will wait for the confirmation on SIG vs CAIQ + SOC2 timing.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Caroline Burns <caroline@healthbridge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, HealthBridge Security <security@healthbridge.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation and scheduling — clarifying ownership & SOC 2 status

Sean —

Thanks for the recap and the template. Quick answers below: 

- SIG vs CAIQ: SIG preferred (we already map to SIG internally).
- SOC 2: in progress, expecting Type II readiness in Q3 2026; we can provide the Type I interim report this quarter if useful.
- HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA is required for the pilot; GDPR controls apply to EU-resident datasets (we'll flag records).
- Evidence owners: 
  - Encryption & infra/networking: Daniel Park (security@healthbridge.com)
  - Dataflow & PII classification: Tasha Reed (tasha.reed@healthbridge.com)

Timeline: we're aiming for security sign-off within 3 weeks of kickoff if no major gaps are found.

I attached our vendor intake PDF (HealthBridge_VendorIntake.pdf) — it has some preferred formats for evidence.

Kickoff: Wed 6/2 14:00 PT works for us. Please send the invite.

-Caroline
Caroline Burns
Director, Partnerships | HealthBridge
caroline@healthbridge.com

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation and scheduling — clarifying ownership & SOC 2 status

Caroline — thanks for the quick clarifications and the intake form. Noted on SIG and the SOC 2 timeline. 

Couple of follow-ups so we come prepared for Wed 6/2 14:00 PT: 
- Monica, can you pull a one-page SOC 2 status summary (control readiness + expected Type I/II dates) and drop it into the Drive folder before the kickoff? That will speed triage.
- For kickoff agenda: (1) owners & timeline alignment, (2) walk through SIG sections we expect to prefill, (3) evidence portals / preferred file formats, (4) handoff to legal for contract terms if needed.
- Evidence items we'll ask for during the kickoff: encryption key management description, network diagram (redacted ok), example logs retention policy, and where SOC2 artifacts will be posted when available.

I’ll send the calendar invite for Wed 6/2 14:00 PT and attach the SIG template. If HealthBridge would rather have a longer first session (30–45m) we can extend.

On contracts: Jordan — please note potential ask: customer may request an exceptions path for a longer SOC 2 timeline; we might propose interim mitigations (IP allowlist, limited dataset).

Thanks — calendar invite coming.

Best,
Sean
